{{Top|leg}}
The '''Jehltekk Enhancer Valve''' was a component of a [[Skiff/Legends|skiff's]] [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]]. If modifying the skiff by [[Plasma welder|plasma welding]] two [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] to the craft to improve maneuverability, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] recommended uing [[Power converter/Legends|power converters]] on them when patching the jet packs to the generator.
